title: systemd user services
whyItMatters: User units started with the session include sync clients, VPN and remote access helpers. The unit names show what keeps running in the background for this account.
source: Arch Wiki, systemd/User: per-user units are kept in ~/.config/systemd/user: https://wiki.archlinux.org/title/Systemd/User
notes: Names only, no recursion. Enabled units also appear as entries inside *.wants folders, which are matched here as names. Packaged units live in /usr/lib/systemd/user and are not counted.

steps: Review the user service unit files located in the folder named in the plan.
Delete any unwanted custom user service files or target symlinks using your file manager.
cleanup.risk: Background services configured for your user session will no longer start automatically.
